title: Update Safety, Privacy, and Grown-ups copy across key screens

requirements.text: Update the Safety Notice page to include: (1) an added emergency guidance paragraph block that says: "If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number" followed by "In many countries this is 112 or 911." followed by "Ask a grown-up to help you call."; and (2) an added age range line that says: "Designed for children ages 4–12 with adult supervision."

quotes:
Add in the emergency guidance section If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number 
In many countries this is 112 or 911.
Ask a grown-up to help you call.  
Add age range “Designed for children ages 4–12 with adult supervision.” to Safety Notice page.

acceptanceCriteria: On frontend/src/pages/SafetyNoticePage.tsx, the Emergency Guidance section includes the three new sentences exactly as provided (including 112/911).
On frontend/src/pages/SafetyNoticePage.tsx, the page includes the exact line: “Designed for children ages 4–12 with adult supervision.”
All new user-facing text on the Safety Notice page is in English.

requirements.text: Update the Privacy & Safety page to add the exact line: “The app works fully offline and does not send information anywhere.”

quotes: Add line “The app works fully offline and does not send information anywhere.” to Privacy page.

acceptanceCriteria: On frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafetyPage.tsx, the exact sentence “The app works fully offline and does not send information anywhere.” appears in the rendered content.
The sentence is visible in normal page flow (not hidden behind an interaction).

requirements.text: Shorten the home (main menu) screen disclaimer text to only: “Not medical advice.”

quotes: Shorten home screen disclaimer to only “Not medical advice.”

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Menu screen (frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx), the bottom disclaimer displayed via ScreenLayout is exactly “Not medical advice.”
This change does not unintentionally remove or alter disclaimers on other screens unless they are also part of the Menu screen UI.

requirements.text: Update the grown-ups entry point label on the Menu screen to: “Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only”.

quotes: Update  label to Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only.

acceptanceCriteria: On frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx, the grown-ups access button label text is exactly “Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only”.
The label is visible without needing to navigate away from the Menu screen.

requirements.text: Update the help message copy to: “Show this to a trusted adult”.

quotes: Also update help message to Show this to a trusted adult

acceptanceCriteria: On the screen where the child is prompted to show their selected feeling to an adult (frontend/src/pages/FeelingConfirmationPage.tsx), the help message shown to the child uses the exact text: “Show this to a trusted adult”.
Any existing call-to-action text on that screen that currently says “Show this to an adult” is updated to match “Show this to a trusted adult”, so the UI is consistent.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn UI components are read-only).
Do not modify immutable hook/bootstrap files (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend is single-actor Motoko; no backend changes are required for copy-only updates.
nonGoals: No new authentication, accounts, or network/data-sync features.
No changes to navigation structure beyond what is needed to display the updated copy.
No backend canister methods or storage changes.
